definition: flag = scores_q >= threshold_q. Segments are runs of labels == 1. Alerts merge runs separated by <= merge_gap_s unflagged points. False alert = overlaps no [start, end + tol_after_s). delay = first flagged point in the segment minus start. See docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md.

residual_cases.definition: Decode the published window channel (v = lo + q/65535*(hi-lo)), subtract the trailing median of the last 61 values (fewer at the start, min_samples=1, mean of the two middle values for even counts), divide by channels[].resid_scale, absolute value. First 600 s of the window.
